en: “She shouldn't be... I didn't hear of anything.”
“Excellent. Then you must bring Shizuko here this evening!”
“Yeahhh, we'd like to throw a special welcome party for you both.”
“Think about it. Since you arrived here, we've not properly welcomed you.”
“Hehe, then it's settled, I can't wait!”
Then for no reason at all, today became a day off.
I didn't need to clean or prep dinner. I didn't need to do any of my regular jobs.
“Why are all the lights out in the house?”
“We're late, we know, but welcome to you both!”
“I think Shizuko's been stunned into silence?”
“I wanted to give her a surprise.”
“They said they wanted to welcome us both here by throwing a welcome party.”
“Welcome party? We're here for work, though.”
“Yeah, I know they mostly act like rich brats.”
The table is full of pizza, fried chicken, fizzy drinks and all sorts of sweet desserts.
“We popped into the city to run some errands today and just picked all this up on the way back!”
“It's all so calorific... Looks like I'll be on a diet for the rest of the week.”
“Erm, you just need to do some exercise.”
“It's good to have a young body...”
Kasumi goes to the fridge and takes out dozens and dozens of different types of beer.
“I don't think you wanna get Kasumi wasted.”
“Hey, y'all said this was a welcome party, let's not hold back!”
“Hehe, you don't want to go too crazy.”
“You know, I've never seen you drink, Kasumi.”
“Last time she drank a good twenty odd bottles to drown her sorrows.”
“Ohhh... Looks like Kazumi and I have something in common!”
“What do you mean why? Because I said so.”
“But I've drank with {Me} plenty of times now...”
“To-Today I'll just drink soda with Shizuku...”
“There's nothing like a beer after work!”
“Gimme a break, there's no customers at the store.”
“Hey, do you have any idea how tiring it is just sitting there staring blankly waiting for no one all day!?”
“But you've been here nearly three months already.”
“So much has happened in that time.”
“And it wasn't all sexy stuff either.”
“Hehe, you've really got my attention now.”
Ayano suddenly moves closer to me and presses her plump body into my arm.
“Come here, show me that pretty face.”
“He didn't show his sexy face to Shizuku.”
“I am a mature lady and I will not be drawn into a conflict over such trivial matters.”
“You're the one who's afraid of drinking.”
“I can't drink, I'll just end up getting wasted.”
“Or do you wanna see me push {Me} over ♡”
“No... No... This is supposed to be a nice party. Let's not go crazy!”
“Heh... Alright. I'll just stay close to you like this!”
“Oh, and you're so coy in private.”
“Just like a little girl, that's why this sexy man hasn't shown you his sexy face.”
“I've seen it plenty of times while he held me shyly in his arms and rubbed me tenderly.”
“Not like you... You pushed this sexy man over and then wouldn't even look at him.”
“Hold up! How did you know about that?”
“You made so much noise, what did you expect?”
“Ahhhh... I'd like to go and crawl off somewhere now...”
“*Pffft* I didn't expect that from you!”
“Is your life here always this terrible?!”
“I wanna just dig a hole and crawl in, okay?!”
“How can you all talk so nonchalantly about all this stuff!”
“Obviously it's because we like you, so we're showing off!”
“Anyway... {Me} isn't exactly coming onto you girls, is he?”
“I've figured out how to get him to come onto me!”
“Hey... {Me}, you just stay here next to me. There's still plenty of pizza!”
“Wow... You look so arrogant right now, Shizuko.”
“Why don't we figure this out with wine and some games?”
“But before the games, we must have another glass, then we can play.”
“The winner can make a request of the loser to answer a question or do something.”
“Of course... You can't lie or refuse.”
“But Shizuku can't drink and I will not accept fizzy drinks.”
“Relax, Shizuku's too delicate for this. I'll take her place.”
“But it's best to not ask why.”
“Hmmm... Let me just think of something to ask...”
“Here goes. Imitate that character off the TV.”
“The cartoon character that's all the rage at the moment. Do the scene where the woman changes shape!”
“Hehe, I helped you do the drinking Shizuku.”
“Hmmm... I've got it. I'll do my best, for {Me}.”
Shizuku walks in front of the TV.
Then she makes fantastic hand signals, moving in line with the TV...
“With love and justice, she turned into stardust...”
“The enchanted young lady, Shizuku ♡ shimmers onto the screen~☆”
Everyone's eyes are fixed on Shizuku.
If someone had been recording, they'd have noticed the obvious way that her cheeks changed color in just three seconds.
“Amazing. Shizuko, this really was a good idea!”
“Enough already... What else was I supposed to do!”
“You're cute and you showed a whole new side of yourself.”
“Well when you put it like that... Hahahaha... We should have filmed it!”
“Pffft, as long {Me} enjoyed it... Shizuko, let's go again!”
“You're not worried about losing again? Guess you've got some balls!”
“Oh please, I've lost once already, I'm not scared anymore!”
“How... How'd you lose ten times... Why can't you guess the right answer...”
“Haha... There's a knack to rock, paper, scissors...”
“That's odd, Shizuko's quite drunk but Kasumi looks fine...?”
“What's that floating around like that... a bottle cap? It's too fast, I can't see it clearly...”
“I can't control myself when I'm drunk...”
What's going on... It's a little scary.
“But... where's Kasumi and why's the ceiling sparkling...”
“Ohhhh... Don't go running off... Can you keep going?”
“Yeah, I can push on. What about you, Shizuko?”
“There's nothing I can do about losing again, just gotta keep drinking.”
“But this time I wanna play the game.”
“You're so drunk... How can you win again...”
“I'm still not even drunk... Alright, what's the question!?”
“You only get one chance so you'd best ask something meaningful.”
“Like if... {Me} was drunk, what would you do?”
“I really enjoy it when he's drunk, it feels really great...”
“Let me tell you guys—when he's drunk—”
The moment Shizuko finishes her sentence, she lies down on the table and starts to snore soundly.
Then—Kasumi goes to the fridge and takes out another dozen beers.
Ayano and Shizuku both suddenly clamp my hands in place.
“Hehe, let's have a drink, shall we?”
“Kasumi... You must be drunk... You should take a rest...”
“Besides, you're the star today. If you don't have a few drinks that just wouldn't be right.”
Then with my hands clamped tight in place, the ladies gently feed me beer after beer.
Despite being held in place, I don't feel bad.
Quite the opposite. I actually feel light as a feather, soft and velvety.
After all, I've got three sexy ladies all feeding me booze...
Ayano suddenly takes the beer and takes a big mouthful.
She squeezes my cheeks with her hands—
Then the next second, she's pressing her lips up against mine and pouring sweet liquor from her lips into mine.
“Oh wow, we're all still here... This is audacious.”
Ayano wipes her mouth, takes another big swig of booze and swoops back in towards me.
“Hehe, you're rushing yourself. You know you can't handle your booze.”
My head's a little dizzy and my body's weak.
“I want that too... I want to feel that forceful, passionate kiss too...”
My body willingly does as Shizuku commands and I open a new bottle of beer.
Then I take a big mouthful and hold Shizuku's cheeks.
“Who'd have thought your first time drinking alcohol would end up like this, Shizuku?”
“Hehe, are you as lousy of a drinker as Ayano?”
“But... anyway, I'm still very happy with what we got.”
I feel like I'm coming back to consciousness.
I seem to remember Ayano was... feeding me booze...
“Yeah... I was so drunk I passed out...”
I take a good look and see Shizuku, Shizuko and Ayano all resting peacefully at my side.
Everyone is covered with a blanket.
She's sitting not far away, she's still drinking.
“I haven't drank like this in a while. Next time we'll have to pay more attention.”
Is it me or does Kasumi look like she's thinking about something.
Just as I'm thinking about speaking, she stands up and starts to assume some weird postures.
“With love and justice, she turned into stardust...”
“The enchanted young lady, Kasumi ♡ shimmers onto the screen~☆”
“I'm nearly 30! I'll never be as cute as Shizuku ever again.”
Is this some kind of new joke that I'm not in on?
I can't tell if it's the swaying or the rhythm, but it's very chic...
She's not doing that just for me, is she?
The next thing I know, my head is hurting like I just got punched.
Before I lose consciousness, I focus with everything I've got...
It was a bottle, one from the front and one from the back, both at the same moment.
Don't tell me that was... Kasumi...
I couldn't tell you why, but after that day, the fridge was always stocked with beer...
